turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
Please send your order number, the email you used at checkout, and the full new delivery address so I can check whether the address can still be changed.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.
I couldn’t change the address for SC-3360 because the parcel has already shipped. A colleague will take over to check whether it can still be redirected. No address change has been made.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer nora.blake@example.com asks that SC-3360 not go to the checkout address and wants delivery to Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu. Policy check returned already_shipped; no change was filed. Please review whether any options remain.
